once: The study employed a one-group pretest–posttest design. Participants were the same 40 second-year pre-service science teachers at a public university who had usable data on both scales at both measurement occasions. The implementation took place within an eight-week course sequence. After the implementation, semi-structured interviews were conducted with four randomly selected participants to describe their experiences of the process. Paired-samples t tests were performed, and interview data were analyzed through content analysis. The interviews provided supplementary information about the implementation.
